title: Kleisli convolution representations and a Margolis--Sakurai version of the modular isomorphism problem
summary: We introduce Kleisli convolution representations for groups, rings, and algebras. We show that their representation categories are equivalent to the usual ones for groups and finite-dimensional algebras, but for rings only recover modules whose underlying Abelian groups are free of finite rank.
